prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production transparent sprite atlas for large speaking waist-up dialogue characters in Glimblehop, matching the approved airy UI concept.
Input images: 1 cast-01-heroes is identity reference for Tish, Luma/Jo and Boom; 2 cast-02-family for Grandpa Koren (left character only); 3 cast-03-village for Shal (right character only); 4 cast-04-rivals for Rusty (middle character only); 5 approved gameplay dialogue UI concept for Luma's speaking pose and rendered finish.
Create exactly SIX separate waist-up / head-to-hips character cutouts in a strict 3-column by 2-row atlas. Square overall canvas, each cell is a tall rectangle. All pixels between characters and behind them must be truly transparent. No labels, no text, no frames, no grid lines, no drop shadows onto background. Characters must not cross into adjacent cells. Leave clear transparent gutter around the entire silhouette including ears and gesturing hands. Each character centered in its own cell, occupy 85% cell height, head near cell top, torso ends at belt/hips near cell bottom. Bottom cut flat and clean at hips, no legs or feet.
Exact cell order reading left-to-right:
TOP LEFT: Tish, compact adult green goblin male, chestnut tuft, coral scarf, little notch in his own left ear, cream shirt and brown stitched travel vest, crossbody satchel strap. Friendly slightly open speaking mouth, one open hand near chest.
TOP MIDDLE: Luma / Jo, adult female green goblin, chestnut side braid, turquoise triangular kerchief and small gold leaf clasp, cream rolled sleeves, brown practical leather vest. Match the UI concept identity closely. Friendly lightly open mouth, palm gently extended to her left as if pointing out a move. Full ears, complete braid and both hands visible.
TOP RIGHT: Boom, substantially broader rounded adult goblin male, olive leaf-like hair tuft, ochre patched vest, cream shirt, soft large backpack rising behind shoulders. Warm kind expression, hands together in a gentle explaining gesture. Broad silhouette not just a bigger Tish face.
BOTTOM LEFT: Grandpa Koren, elderly green goblin, white eyebrows and cream moustache/beard, round gold glasses, cream shirt, brown craft apron, tool strap. Calm encouraging speaking expression, one finger raised slightly. No lantern prop.
BOTTOM MIDDLE: Shal, older adult goblin ferryman, wide straw hat, short white chin tuft, dark forest-green cape and cream shirt, friendly dry smile. One open hand, no long paddle extending outside cell.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Rusty, young adult goblin male, orange-red pointed tuft, dark red vest over cream shirt, round acorn badge on chest, narrow athletic torso. Confident friendly speaking smile, open hand, no aggressive fist.
Style: rich soft stylized 3D storybook illustration with detailed warm fabric and worn leather, large amber eyes and pink inner ears, warm forest fairy-tale, same identities and quality as references. These are dialogue sprites, no painted rectangular portrait cards. Consistent soft studio lighting, readable separated silhouettes, transparent alpha.
Avoid: extra characters, head-only busts, full-body legs, tiny portraits, word labels, backgrounds, borders, white matte, overlap, cropped ears/hands/hats, new clothes/colors, generic anime, lip-sync strip.

Edit the attached transparent six-character dialogue atlas. Preserve the six identities, speaking expressions, detailed 3D storybook rendering and clothing exactly. Fix only production atlas spacing, safe silhouettes, and Jo's hair color.
The entire square canvas must be a STRICT 3 columns x 2 rows grid with each of SIX figures completely isolated in its own cell. Transparent empty gutters of at least 8% of each cell width around EVERY figure on all sides. No silhouette pixel, hand, ear, backpack or hat may cross a column or row boundary. Currently Jo's hand extends into Boom's cell and the lower characters touch cell edges: fix that. Reduce each character's width and adjust Jo's extended hand to a closer open-palm speaking gesture within her own cell. Make the six upper bodies slightly smaller as needed so ALL ears, hats, forearms and torso sides are visible and have transparent padding. Keep a clean flat waist/hips cutoff at the bottom within EACH cell, with transparent padding below it.
Cell order unchanged:
row 1 Tish / Jo / Boom.
row 2 Grandpa Koren / Shal / Rusty.
Jo in the TOP MIDDLE has dark CHESTNUT BROWN braided hair instead of green-gray, turquoise scarf and gold leaf clasp. Tish coral scarf, Boom wide ochre silhouette, Koren glasses and cream beard, Shal wide straw hat and green cape, Rusty orange tuft and dark red vest all unchanged.
Genuinely transparent alpha background, no panels, labels, text, shadows, grid lines or new objects. This is a sprite atlas to slice automatically into six equal rectangles; isolation and safe padding are essential.

Production correction of this transparent atlas ONLY: there is still not enough spacing between columns. Keep all SIX characters, clothes, faces, expressions and colors unchanged. Make EVERY character 25% smaller, centered in its SAME grid cell. In particular shrink Boom (top right) enough so his left elbow and backpack are nowhere near Jo's cell; shrink Koren's hand so it does not approach Shal's cell. The six cell centers are at (1/6,1/4), (1/2,1/4), (5/6,1/4), (1/6,3/4), (1/2,3/4), (5/6,3/4) of the square canvas.
Each silhouette including all ears/hats/arms must fit in a rectangle with width 25% of the entire canvas and height 36% of the entire canvas, centered at the corresponding cell center. This leaves substantial EMPTY TRANSPARENT SPACE between figures. Lots of empty space is intentional and required for automatic sprite slicing. At least 4% of entire canvas width between adjacent silhouettes. Six separate floating waist-up cutouts; no overlap or contact and no visible pixels near cell boundaries. True transparent background with no labels, panels, new objects or shadows. Keep Jo's brown braid and the exact reading order Tish / Jo / Boom, then Koren / Shal / Rusty.
notes: Native Unity Sprite Editor slicing trims transparent margins; PNG pixels unchanged.
